candidates.title: HeatCache: Thermal-aware Energy-efficient LLM Inference Scheduling for Chassis-level Liquid Cooling in Sustainable Edge Server Rooms
candidates.reason: vLLM-based thermal-aware inference scheduler that treats liquid-cooling loops as a temporary heat buffer; reports up to 18.0% compute-energy reduction, 81.7% less thermal-throttle exposure, and <0.9% SLO violations at high ambient temperature.

candidates.title: ETCInfer: An Energy-efficient Thermal-aware Cooling-joint Scheduler for LLM Inference in AI Datacenters
candidates.reason: Joint facility/device control for LLM inference, coordinating CRAC setpoint, GPU frequency and micro-batch size under thermal/SLO constraints; reports up to 33.1% total-job energy reduction and 92.9% less throttle exposure with validation experiments.
